ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels exceeding 90% of surface area, with sparse high-intensity (white) mottling localized to margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is solid dark pigmentation; small high-contrast white clusters (mottling) are mapped to the distal trailing edge of the right lobe and sparsely at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude peaks across the entire trailing edge boundary; most jagged profile observed on the inner right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep along the trailing margins tapering to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white pigmentation/scarring along the extreme right tip and lower trailing edge boundary of the right lobe.
